# Ancaster Heating & Cooling

> Ancaster Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Ancaster, Hamilton-Wentworth, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (905) 304-7182  |  Email: contact@ancasterheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://ancasterheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Ancaster, Hamilton, Stoney Creek, Dundas, Waterdown, Binbrook, Mount Hope
